diffs.name: Salesforce
diffs.reason: The live extracted Salesforce REST API Developer Guide (https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/intro_oauth_and_connected_apps.htm) explicitly includes 'Generating an OpenAPI 3.0 Document for sObjects REST API (Beta)' in its official documentation navigation.

diffs.name: Pipedrive
diffs.reason: The official Pipedrive CRM API page (https://www.pipedrive.com/en/features/crm-api) explicitly states developers can access what they need via webhooks and API endpoints.

diffs.name: Copper
diffs.reason: Copper's pricing page (copper.com/pricing) and partner FAQ (copper.com/partners) confirm self-serve account signup with API & Embedded integration SDK gated to paid Professional/Business plans, and partners required to purchase a Business license for a demo account.

diffs.name: Zendesk
diffs.reason: Zendesk's official API authentication article (https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests) explicitly documents Zendesk webhooks, the Add webhook configuration page, Test webhook functionality, and OAuth authentication for webhooks.

diffs.name: Pylon
diffs.reason: Pylon's official pricing page (https://www.usepylon.com/pricing) explicitly lists Webhooks under Developer platform features as included on Professional, Advanced, and Enterprise plans.

diffs.name: Front
diffs.reason: https://dev.frontapp.com/docs/partnering-with-front explicitly states developers can sign up for a free development account (so no paid customer account is required to build), while public integrations for Front customers must use OAuth and undergo technical approval (and potential security/legal review) to be published in the Front App Store.

diffs.name: Plain
diffs.reason: Plain exposes a GraphQL-only API (https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1) with a GraphQL SDL schema at https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1/schema.graphql, not a REST OpenAPI specification.

diffs.name: Help Scout
diffs.reason: Help Scout's Free plan explicitly excludes API access and integrations (docs.helpscout.com/article/1140-mailbox-api and helpscout.com/pricing/); paid Standard, Plus, or Pro plans are required for API/MCP access, and Plus/Pro is required for Reporting endpoints.

diffs.name: Twilio
diffs.reason: The primary doc https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/requests-to-twilio explicitly covers how the Twilio APIs handle webhooks, and the live Composio production catalog confirms 45 webhook/event triggers.

diffs.name: Telegram
diffs.reason: The live Telegram Bot API documentation at https://core.telegram.org/bots/api/ explicitly documents webhooks as one of the two supported methods for receiving bot updates (alongside getUpdates), including webhook URL, port, and max_webhook_connections configuration.

diffs.name: Aircall
diffs.reason: Primary Aircall sources (https://aircall.io/pricing/ FAQ and https://aircall.io/blog/tech/ai-ecosystem-developer-guide/) explicitly confirm Aircall offers an open webhook framework for real-time call and contact events set up after user authorization.

diffs.name: Vonage
diffs.reason: The live Getting Started Overview doc (https://developer.vonage.com/en/getting-started/overview) explicitly states under the OpenAPI section: 'Each of our APIs has its own OpenAPI specification.'

diffs.name: Google Ads
diffs.reason: Replaced 1 broken/dead URL(s): ['https://support.google.com/adspolicy/answer/6169371?hl=en']

diffs.name: Mailchimp
diffs.reason: The live Mailchimp API structure documentation at https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/fundamentals/ explicitly states: 'We use the OpenAPI Specification (formerly known as Swagger) to describe each endpoint.'

diffs.name: SendGrid
diffs.reason: The official SendGrid v3 API reference (https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference) explicitly lists an OpenAPI specification under SDKs and tools.

diffs.name: BigCommerce
diffs.reason: The BigCommerce developer documentation at https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/ai-agent-setup explicitly confirms that developers can download BigCommerce OpenAPI Specifications for schema-aware workflows.

diffs.name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
diffs.reason: While developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/get-started/ notes the core CRUD Web API framework does not support webhooks, Adobe's official Commerce Developer Agent announcement (business.adobe.com/blog/commerce-developer-agent) confirms Adobe Commerce supports webhooks via App Builder extensibility.

diffs.name: MrScraper
diffs.reason: MrScraper billing docs (https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/billing) and pricing page (https://mrscraper.com/pricing) confirm a self-serve Scraper Free plan with no credit card required that includes monthly tokens and API token access.

diffs.name: GitHub
diffs.reason: The live extracted GitHub Rate Limits documentation explicitly confirms GitHub provides a GraphQL API alongside its REST API ('The GraphQL API also has a separate primary rate limit. See Rate limits and query limits for the GraphQL API.').

diffs.name: Clay
diffs.reason: Clay's pricing page (https://www.clay.com/pricing) and MCP docs (https://university.clay.com/docs/clay-mcp-in-chatgpt) confirm a self-serve Free plan and 14-day trial that both include Public API/CLI access (100 search results/30 days) and Clay MCP, aligning with buildability_verdict 'Ready Today (Easy Win)'.

diffs.name: Notion
diffs.reason: Notion's official pricing page (https://www.notion.com/pricing) explicitly lists Webhooks under API automations & integrations alongside Public API, corroborated by 8 triggers in the Composio production catalog.

diffs.name: Linear
diffs.reason: Primary docs (https://linear.app/developers/graphql and https://linear.app/docs/api-and-webhooks) state that Linear's public API is strictly GraphQL using GraphQL schema introspection (explorable via Apollo Studio) rather than REST, with no OpenAPI specification provided.

diffs.name: Monday.com
diffs.reason: The primary developer documentation (https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/getting-started and https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/build-on-monday-with-ai) specifies that Monday.com exposes a single-endpoint GraphQL API (https://api.monday.com/v2) using a GraphQL schema and schema introspection rather than REST or an OpenAPI specification.

diffs.name: ClickUp
diffs.reason: ClickUp's official FAQ (https://clickup.com/faqs) explicitly states that webhook support is available alongside its public REST API and OAuth, corroborated by 21 triggers in the live Composio production catalog.

diffs.name: Xero
diffs.reason: The live Xero Developer Pricing page (https://developer.xero.com/pricing) explicitly lists Webhooks under Standard features across all plans (Starter, Core, Plus, Advanced, and Enterprise).

diffs.name: Mermaid CLI
diffs.reason: https://mermaid.ai/docs/ai/mcp-server documents the separate commercial Mermaid Chart SaaS MCP server (mcp.mermaid.ai, requiring a Mermaid Chart account), not an official MCP server for the open-source mermaid-js/mermaid-cli package, whose GitHub README and npm page contain no MCP server.

diffs.name: Devin
diffs.reason: https://docs.devin.ai/admin/billing/self-serve and https://devin.ai/pricing confirm Devin offers self-serve signup at app.devin.ai with Free ($0), Pro ($20/mo, explicitly including MCP integrations), Max ($200/mo), and Teams ($80/mo) plans rather than requiring a pre-existing enterprise customer admin account.

diffs.name: higgsfield
diffs.reason: Consistent with Self-Serve Paid Plan access_model: API calls require registering a payment method and funding a prepaid USD balance ($5 minimum top-up) with zero-balance request rejection, and official MCP/CLI always deduct paid plan credits with no free generations.

diffs.name: higgsfield
diffs.reason: Replaced 1 broken/dead URL(s): ['https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/integrations/what-is-higgsfield-api']

diffs.name: Grain
diffs.reason: Grain's official support docs (https://support.grain.com/en/articles/15507288-grain-api) refer to PATs and WATs as Personal/Workspace API tokens, and the live Composio production catalog confirms API_KEY as the production auth mode for Grain.
